title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code mods (v2.1.287, 1 Oct)
bullets.summary: Anthropic ships TypeScript-based 'mods' for customizing Claude Code behavior, UI and features with granular control over tool calls and prompts, alongside improved plugin/MCP handling.
bullets.how: The Construct: evaluate mods for custom hooks/status and approval gates on scheduled agents; also migrate anything pinned to Sonnet 4.5 before 30 Nov.

bullets.title: OpenAI unveils 'Dots' always-on agent, $500 premium tier; seeks $30B at $1.4T
bullets.summary: OpenAI launched an always-on agent called Dots and a $500 subscription tier while pursuing $30B at a $1.4T valuation after delaying its IPO; run-rate revenue is above $40B.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: always-on personal agents set client expectations for persistent operators; price anchor for premium agent tiers. The Construct: benchmark against our scheduled-routine model.

bullets.title: Instinct raises $1B Series C at $10B for consumer task agent
bullets.summary: Instinct, an agent that books travel, makes purchases and cancels subscriptions, raised $1B from Sequoia, Benchmark and others, facing competition from Meta's Muse and privacy concerns.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: validates demand for do-it-for-me agents; privacy/data-scope is the open wedge for operator consulting.

bullets.title: Armadin (Kevin Mandia) raises $255.5M at $2.5B for agent-swarm security testing
bullets.summary: Armadin uses AI agent swarms that chain vulnerabilities for continuous security testing instead of periodic pen tests; total funding above $445M.
bullets.how: The Construct: swarm-based continuous testing is a pattern to borrow for our own site/agent health sentinels. PRAGMA: security-minded agent audits are a sellable add-on.

bullets.title: Reco raises $55M as agent-security startups crowd the market
bullets.summary: Reco raised $55M amid a growing field of AI agent security/governance startups.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: agent inventory and supervision is becoming a budget line. The Construct: keep a registry of every scheduled agent with owner and permission scope.

praxis_lesson: Money is flowing to both ends of the agent stack: always-on agents (OpenAI Dots, Instinct) and the security layer that tests and supervises them (Armadin, Reco). Pair every autonomous Construct job with an owner, a scoped permission set, and continuous verification.
